confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is least certain given limited Iquique-specific knowledge and uncertain July demand (Chilean winter school holidays). Drink prices are inferred from typical Chilean restaurant pricing. The FX value comes from search-result summaries of RBA statistics, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of mid-sized Chilean coastal cities (e.g., Antofagasta, La Serena) and Latin American port tourism towns, adjusted for Iquique's duty-free zone, which can make some goods cheaper. Drink prices use the typical Chilean relationship in which a cocktail or wine glass costs roughly 1.3–1.5x a draft beer.
